# Norway

[global-law](../) / Norway

1 repository under this folder (1 legislation, whole country). Each row links to the repository's current `main`; the folder of the same path is the submodule global-law pins and reads. "Coverage" is what the corpus says of itself; freshness is global-law's monitor.

## Completeness, checked against the official sources (2026-11-12)

| Constitution | Main codes | National law | Law-making regions | Case law |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| held | 100% | 93% | 0% | 0% |

norway-law holds 698 of Lovdata's 753 laws and 3,357 central regulations, including all 7 essentials, but only 31 acts (Grunnloven, straffeloven, tvisteloven, arbeidsmiljøloven among them) have real in-force history. The rest, including straffeprosessloven, avtaleloven and forvaltningsloven, are one current Lovdata consolidation each. The two straffeloven/arbeidsmiljøloven spot checks match Lovdata, but Grunnloven misses Stortinget's decision of 3 November 2026 (§§ 25, 26, 41, 75), and there is no case law and no local regulation.

Shares are of what exists, not of what each repository says it holds; estimates are marked, with their method in [data/completeness.json](../data/completeness.json).
